text:
maya: Quick sync — planning to flip on the new precision backstop flag for fp16->int8 cascade tomorrow morning. Want to confirm rollout plan + guardrails.

jordan: timeline?

maya: target 06:00 UTC, start at 10% for 2h, then 50% for 4h, then evaluate. Canary audience = internal-beta + region=us-east-1. Open to suggestions.

samir: can we add automatic rollback on tok_error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency increase > 40ms? also require the post-stage eval set to run automatically.

ellie: added those to the runbook. flag name `feature.precision_backstop.v2` — draft config below:

``
flag: feature.precision_backstop.v2
audience: [internal-beta]
regions: [us-east-1]
stages: [{pct:10, duration:2h}, {pct:50, duration:4h}]
rollback_triggers: ["tok_error_rate>0.5%","p95_latency_diff>40ms"]
metrics_watch: ["tok_error_rate","p95_latency","retries","generation_quality"]
opt_out_tag: no_precision_rewrite
``

maya: perfect. @ops-bot can you schedule the canary for 06:00 UTC and ensure the eval suite runs after each stage?

ops-bot: deploy scheduled for 1784009200 (06:00 UTC). Health checks and automatic rollback hooks configured. Will post smoke eval results to this thread.

jordan: also pinging infra for extra GPU headroom during the 50% stage — @samir please coordinate capacity and autoscaler overrides.

samir: on it. requested +2 GPU nodes in us-east-1 for the window and set a temporary scaling policy. Will confirm before flip.

ellie: one more ask — add partner opt-out tag `no_precision_rewrite` to the rollout checker and update the rollout script to respect partner contracts. I’ll open a tiny PR.

maya: thanks all. I’ll mark the runbook PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runs/PR1234 :thumbsup:

jordan: lgtm, will review now.

ops-bot: smoke eval complete (pre-canary) — no regressions on the quick sample: tok_error_rate=0.12%, p95_latency_diff=+12ms, quality-stable=true.

maya: excellent. locking in schedule and will follow up in the morning if anything changes.
